test_leaky_clip_by_value_forward: test the leaky_clip_by_value function clips tensor values to specified min and max bounds
test_leaky_clip_by_value_backward: test the leaky_clip_by_value function custom gradient behavior with GradientTape
test_leaky_clip_by_value_scalar_clipping: test the leaky_clip_by_value function with scalar clip_min and clip_max values
test_leaky_clip_by_value_array_clipping: test the leaky_clip_by_value function with per-element clip_min and clip_max arrays
test_leaky_clip_by_value_gradient_flow: test the leaky_clip_by_value function gradient passes through when values are within bounds
